notes:
In ABNF, concatenation binds tighter than  / , so the repeated element groups as  (["-"] lalpha) / DIGIT . The optional hyphen attaches only to the letter branch, not to the digit branch.  However the preceding prose implies that a hyphen before a digit should be allowed:

    "The name MUST only contain ASCII lowercase alphabetic and numeric characters, optionally separated by hyphens."

Add parentheses so the hyphen applies to the whole letter-or-digit alternation.

See RFC5234, section 3.10 ("Operator Precedence"), especially the last two lines.
